resources.string: Shares use this default computer even when another computer is open in the app. Aliases help identify a computer in requests.
Could not save the change. Check that the computer is still paired.
Use up to eight aliases, each at most 64 characters, without control characters.
This computer is no longer paired.
Routing settings need to be reset before sharing can continue.
Your default computer is no longer paired. Select a new default or clear it.
Pair a computer in the app to send work to it.
One alias per line. Leave empty to remove all aliases. Duplicate aliases across computers require a selection.
Review the material and add your instructions. Nothing is sent until you submit.
No execution tools loaded. Check the computer connection and refresh.
Choose a provider or refresh to load the available models.
This submission keeps its original material, computer and execution options.
Accepted by the computer. This does not mean the Agent has finished.
Accepted and queued by the computer. Execution has not been confirmed.
The submission result is not confirmed. Check the receipt before starting another task.
The submission deadline has passed. Copy as a new draft to submit again.
The computer has not confirmed acceptance.
Allows this task to continue after leaving this screen. Notifications must be enabled. Android may pause background work; use its notification to stop delivery.
Sending this task. Task execution may continue on the computer after delivery.
Phone wrote %1$s of this file, total %2$s, to the connection; the computer has not confirmed it yet.
Verifying the file receipt from your computer.
Saved on this phone. Restoring does not send it.
Check your input, computer and execution options. Combined input must fit within 48 KiB.
This input or computer does not support the operation.
Checking this computer’s project routing support…
This computer does not provide the required project routing protocol. Update or check its Ragent service. Your draft is saved.
Could not check this computer’s project routing support. Your draft is saved.
Could not connect to the selected computer. Your draft is retained.
Sign in or pair this computer again in the app, then resume.
This action or resource is not authorized.
This draft changed elsewhere. Reopen it from saved drafts to review the latest version.
The saved material could not be found.
Could not continue. Your saved draft can be reopened from Sharing and agents.
No saved drafts yet. Share text from another app to get started.
File upload is not fully confirmed. Resume this submission to continue.
Saving shared files on this phone…
This file was not saved. Share it again, or explicitly remove it before submitting.
No retained acceptance evidence. Keep the original submission identity.
The task is queued; no final result yet.
The final reply is not published yet. Check again later.
The task is running; no final result yet.
The task failed. No final reply is returned.
The task was cancelled. No final reply is returned.
No text was published in this result.
This text is a shortened preview. The full reply remains in the original computer session.
This result includes files. Open Task files from the saved task to download and export them.
This selection is read-only. Submitting saves a task; the source text stays unchanged.
After submitting, a complete text result can replace the selection. Longer tasks stay saved for later.
Replace selected text with this result
Keep source text and save task for later
View this task in Ragent → Settings → Sharing and agents → Saved share drafts.
Reopening restores local records. Querying, downloading and exporting require an explicit action.
Query the original computer to obtain the output manifest.
No local files for this task.
Partial download; resume uses the original revision
Download failed; remove the copy before retrying
Revocation blocks new access. Previously received bytes and open descriptors cannot be recalled.
Local transfer stopped. The private source and checkpoints are retained; the PC task continues.
Sharing requested. Delivery to the receiving app is not confirmed.
Document selection cancelled; private files retained.
Save completion is unconfirmed. The external document may be incomplete. Check save history before starting a new explicit save.
Temporary access revoked; the private source is retained.
This output action is no longer valid. Refresh local records before retrying.
The output changed or is in use. Refresh local records; a changed remote version needs a new download.
The remote manifest or temporary copy expired. Query PC outputs or prepare a fresh export; the PC task is not resubmitted.
Output storage limit reached. Delete unneeded phone copies, revoke temporary access or clear finished save history before retrying.
Output access is busy. Wait and refresh local records before retrying.
The output could not be verified. Refresh local records or query PC outputs before retrying.
Could not complete the output action. Review local records before retrying; a selected external document may contain partial data.
Waiting for a system document selection.
Save was interrupted or could not be confirmed. Choose a new save action to try again.
The selected external document may contain partial data. The private source is retained.
Reopening never rewrites documents. Clearing finished history removes local records only.

Choose permissions and computers for this new access record. Check the package and certificate; developers choose their app names. Confirmation adds this record. Existing access remains until revoked in App access.
Submit a prepared task to a computer
Revoke access any time in App access. Revocation blocks further API access; it does not stop already accepted PC work or recall received data.
Access could not be updated (%1$s). Review the current request or refresh local records. No new permission is inferred.

Access is off until you add a delegation. A delegation applies to every platform-certified AppFunctions caller, not only Gemini. Those callers share access to tasks created under that delegation. Choose computers, permissions and duration. Revoking access does not stop work already accepted by a computer.
Assistant integration is being added. Granting access does not guarantee your device or Gemini can call these functions.
Leave a field blank to allow all existing sessions or projects within the selected computers. Otherwise enter exact IDs separated by commas or newlines.
I understand this grants access to all platform-certified AppFunctions callers
Choose how Ragent should handle this share
Review the content on the next screen before you send or save it.
Review the material and prepare work for a paired computer.
Continue with a temporary pairing, without signing in to Google.
Add reference text, or start with your instructions.
Summarize the shared material and highlight the key points.
Translate the shared material into English, preserving its meaning and structure.
Extract actionable next steps from the shared material.
No shared text. Files stay attached to the task.
This is reference material. Add what you want done in the task instructions.
Choose the computer for this task. Its identity stays fixed after submission.

Could not reconnect to the temporary computer. Open Ragent and scan a fresh code if access expired.
This account has reached its active connection limit. Free a connection slot, then try again.
Update Ragent on this computer to choose an AI agent for temporary sharing, then scan its new code.
